headlines.headline_text: Capital Chronicle report update: EIA released October 15, 2026: storage rose 67 Bcf in the week ended October 9, versus the five-year same-week average of 90 Bcf; stocks were 3567 Bcf, 45 Bcf above that average and 143 Bcf below last year.
